prompt: A long telephoto view from across a wide night avenue, the perspective flattened. A cream 1920s roadster with its top down sits sharp in the middle of the frame in clean side profile, whitewall tyres, one driver in a dark hat low at the wheel. Directly behind it, packed and compressed, a wall of lit storefronts glowing purple and gold, shop windows and awnings with no readable signs. A thin ribbon of wet road along the bottom catches both colours. No pedestrians, no other vehicles. The car is crisp from bumper to bumper. Thanks.
